retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of three fashionably dressed figures under a large, arched, multi-colored typographic header with geometric background accents.
triggerTerms: arched block lettering with geometric shapes

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1980s-inspired composition featuring three female figures in eclectic fashion (lace, leopard print, and oversized hats) posed against a stark white background, framed by a large arched title in bold sans-serif type and pastel geometric squiggles.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched typography framing the subjects from above
High-contrast subjects against a clean white negative space
Repetition of three distinct fashion personas
Geometric pastel shapes layered behind the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched title at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched title, move down to the central figure, then scan left and right to the other two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space in the center and lower-middle areas provides breathing room for the busy fashion and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and clothing patterns against a high-value white background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with minimal stroke contrast
Letters follow a precise upward arc
Individual letters are slightly rotated to follow the curve tangent
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' characters are enlarged and placed over geometric lavender shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif for the main title paired with a delicate, high-contrast condensed serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Yellow squiggled pattern at the very top edge
Thin horizontal rules underlining secondary text

avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy sans-serif feel of the main title.
Provides the necessary high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of three women in 80s pop fashion (one in leopard print, one in lace leggings, one in a black beret) against a pure white background. Include a pale yellow squiggle pattern at the top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title in a heavy blue and teal sans-serif font. Place lavender geometric shapes behind the first letter of each word. Add a small, condensed serif subtitle in the upper left with a thin underline.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct figures in 80s fashion?
Are the lavender geometric shapes present behind the text?

adjustableVariables: Specific fashion patterns (e.g., leopard to zebra)
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text arc is smooth and symmetrical.
Ensure the figures do not overlap the main title text.
Verify the high-contrast lighting on the subjects.
Confirm the presence of the pastel geometric accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio photography + Arched bold sans-serif header + Geometric pastel accents + Eclectic 80s fashion styling.
